text: A psalm of David. ADONAI, who may dwell in Your tent? Who may live on Your holy mountain?
The one who walks with integrity, who does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart,
who does not slander with his tongue, does not wrong his neighbor, and does not disgrace his friend,
who despises a vile person in his eyes, but honors those who fear ADONAI, who keeps his oath even when it hurts, and does not change,
who lends his money without usury, and takes no bribe against the innocent. One who does these things will never be shaken.
